project: Wuxia Life P2 Gameplay Structure and Persistence
description: Strengthen gameplay structure after P1 by building a clear choice feedback loop, route and identity continuity rules, real gameplay simulation coverage, and reliable save/load integration for the main flow.

userStories.title: Confirm P1 Baseline
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want to confirm the P1 baseline before P2 implementation so that P2 does not build on unfinished event quality work.
acceptanceCriteria: P1 PRD and P1 delivery evidence or implementation notes are reviewed
P1 entry status is recorded as complete, partial, waived, or blocked
Affected P2 stories are identified if P1 evidence is incomplete
No business code is changed
userStories.notes: P1 baseline reviewed against docs/PRD/p1-event-quality-and-rhythm.prd.json and docs/test-reports/us-022-p1-closure-verification.md. Entry status: complete. Affected P2 stories due to incomplete P1 evidence: none.

userStories.title: Inventory Choice Feedback Sources
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to know where choice result text, effects, relationship changes, and route changes come from so that feedback design reuses existing data.
acceptanceCriteria: Choice events, outcomes, effects, lastOutcomeText, event history, relationships, and route changes are inventoried
Each feedback source is classified as immediate, long-term, hidden, or diagnostic
Current feedback gaps are listed
No business code is changed
userStories.notes: Completed read-only inventory in `docs/test-reports/us-002-choice-feedback-source-inventory.md`. Mapped source/read-write paths for choice events, outcomes, effects, `lastOutcomeText`, event history, relationships, and route-change signals; classified each source as immediate/long-term/hidden/diagnostic; documented current feedback gaps (route causality visibility, relationship causality trace, risk hints, hidden long-term impact visibility, and missing unified feedback object). No business code changed.

userStories.title: Define Structured Choice Feedback Model
userStories.description: As a player, I want choice results to explain what happened, what changed, and what future consequence was opened.
acceptanceCriteria: Feedback model fields include narrative result, stat impact, relationship impact, route impact, long-term flags, and risk hints
Player-facing fields and test/log-only fields are separated
Fallback behavior for missing feedback is defined
Design notes are written
userStories.notes: Defined `ChoiceFeedbackModel` and fallback contract in `src/types/choiceFeedback.ts`, including narrative/stat/relationship/route/long-term/risk fields with explicit player vs diagnostic visibility boundaries. Added deterministic fallback helper `createChoiceFeedbackFallback` and design notes in `docs/test-reports/us-003-structured-choice-feedback-model.md`.

userStories.title: Implement Choice Feedback Generator
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a single feedback generation entry so that choices, auto-resolved choices, and simulation reports do not each invent feedback logic.
acceptanceCriteria: A unified feedback generation entry is added or existing feedback logic is consolidated
Manual choices and auto-resolved choices can produce the same feedback structure
Raw diagnostic fields are not exposed directly to players
npm run typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Added unified `generateChoiceFeedback` entry in `src/core/ChoiceFeedbackGenerator.ts` and integrated it into `useNewGameEngine.handleChoice`, so manual and auto-resolved choices both persist the same `ChoiceFeedbackModel` structure in `engineState.lastChoiceFeedback` while player UI reads only `player.narrativeResult`. Added regression assertions in `tests/AllTests.ts`; `npm run typecheck` and `npm test` pass.

userStories.title: Display Choice Feedback in Main Flow
userStories.description: As a player, I want clear post-choice results and key long-term impacts in the main flow.
acceptanceCriteria: Main gameplay displays structured feedback after choices
Stat, relationship, and route impacts follow the approved display rules
A narrative fallback is shown when structured feedback is incomplete
npm run build passes
userStories.notes: Integrated structured choice feedback rendering in `src/components/GameScreen.vue`: main flow now displays narrative + structured stat/relationship/route/long-term impacts from `engineState.lastChoiceFeedback.player`, shows narrative fallback hint when structured details are incomplete, and clears feedback state on continue. Fixed `ChoiceFeedbackGenerator` effect type imports (`eventTypes`) to keep build type contracts consistent. Validation passed: `npm run typecheck`, `npm test`, `npm run build`.

userStories.title: Add Choice Feedback Regression Tests
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want feedback tests so that future event content does not regress to vague choice results.
acceptanceCriteria: Tests cover stat changes, relationship changes, route changes, long-term flags, and fallback text
Tests cover manual choice events and auto-resolved choice events
npm test passes
userStories.notes: Added regression coverage in `tests/AllTests.ts` for structured choice feedback fields across manual and auto-resolved choices. Tests now assert stat impacts, relationship impacts, route transitions, long-term flags, and narrative fallback text behavior for missing narrative input. Validation passed: `npm run typecheck`, `npm test`.

userStories.title: Inventory Route Identity and Faction Fields
userStories.description: As a designer, I want existing route, identity, faction, sect, karma, relationship, and critical choice fields inventoried before defining conflict rules.
acceptanceCriteria: Identity, route, faction, sect, critical choice, karma, and relationship fields are inventoried
Each field includes source, write points, read points, and meaning
Fields are classified as main-flow, legacy-compatible, or suspected-deprecated
No business code is changed

userStories.title: Define Route Categories and Lifecycle
userStories.description: As a player, I want routes to have a clear start, development, lock-in, turn, completion, or failure shape.
acceptanceCriteria: Main route, secondary route, conflicting route, temporary state, completed state, and failed state are defined
Route lifecycle state machine is documented
Route switching, lock-in, and ending rules are defined
Design notes are written

userStories.title: Define Route Compatibility Rules
userStories.description: As a designer, I want route conflict and compatibility rules so that the player does not become contradictory identities at the same time.
acceptanceCriteria: Conflict and compatibility are defined for at least merchant, hero, sect, demonic, official, hermit, or wanderer routes
Strong mutual exclusion, soft mutual exclusion, and coexistence are distinguished
Conflict resolution behavior is defined
Rules are written as a testable table

userStories.title: Implement Route State Management Base
userStories.description: As a developer, I want one route state management entry so that events do not hand-write route flags everywhere.
acceptanceCriteria: Route state can be read, written, locked, completed, and failed through a unified entry
Existing identity and faction fields are not broken
Key route state changes can be recorded in event or route history
npm run typecheck passes

userStories.title: Apply Route Conflict Checks
userStories.description: As a player, I want locked-in routes to affect later events and choices so that life choices have lasting consequences.
acceptanceCriteria: Conflicting route events do not trigger in invalid states
Soft-conflict route transitions are handled through explicit turn events
Route lock-in state is traceable
npm test passes

userStories.title: Add Route Progression and Breakage Tests
userStories.description: As a designer, I want tests for route completion and breakage so that route structure is not only judged by feel.
acceptanceCriteria: Tests cover route start, progress, lock-in, conflict block, completion, failure, or breakage
At least two different route types are covered
npm test passes

userStories.title: Define Real Gameplay Simulation Metrics
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want real gameplay simulation metrics that cover playability, not only whether the loop runs.
acceptanceCriteria: Metrics include choice rate, auto event rate, route completion rate, route breakage rate, death rate, ending distribution, romance/family achievement rate, and save count
Metrics include target ranges or observation baselines
Metrics are classified as blocker, warning, or info

userStories.title: Implement Fixed-Seed Gameplay Simulation
userStories.description: As a developer, I want gameplay simulation to be repeatable so that regression results can be compared.
acceptanceCriteria: Simulation supports fixed random seeds
Simulation supports complete-life or specified age-range runs
Simulation outputs machine-readable results and human-readable summaries
Simulation runs without browser UI

userStories.title: Add Multi-Route Simulation Samples
userStories.description: As a designer, I want simulation samples for different origins, routes, and choice tendencies so that one life path does not hide structural issues.
acceptanceCriteria: At least three simulation personas or choice strategies are defined
Each sample outputs route, ending, choice, death, and relationship summaries
Samples can be rerun with a local command

userStories.title: Define Simulation Thresholds and Gate
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want simulation to produce pass or fail signals instead of only attractive reports.
acceptanceCriteria: Blocking simulation metrics are defined
Warning-only simulation metrics are defined
Waiver list support requires reasons
npm test passes

userStories.title: Inventory Current Save State Shape
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to know what the save system persists before wiring it to the main flow.
acceptanceCriteria: Saved fields, loaded fields, version fields, missing fields, and derived fields are inventoried
Inventory covers player, current event, event history, route, identity, relationship, ending, and time state
No business code is changed

userStories.title: Define Save Version and Compatibility Boundary
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a P2 save version strategy so future state changes do not silently corrupt old saves.
acceptanceCriteria: P2 save version or schema marker is defined
Readable legacy version range is defined
Unsupported legacy save behavior is defined
Full historical migration is explicitly out of scope

userStories.title: Connect Save and Load to Main Flow
userStories.description: As a player, I want to save and load progress from the real game flow so that long-form life simulation is playable.
acceptanceCriteria: Main flow can save the current life state
Loading restores player, time, event history, route, relationship, and ending-related state
Continuing after load does not reset key state
npm run typecheck passes

userStories.title: Define Restart Continue and Ending Save Behavior
userStories.description: As a player, I want restart, continue, and post-ending save behavior to be predictable.
acceptanceCriteria: Restart does not corrupt existing saves
Continuing after loading a save resumes the correct flow state
Post-ending save display or load behavior follows the approved design
npm run build passes

userStories.title: Add Save Regression Tests
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want save regression tests so route, relationship, and event history do not disappear after load.
acceptanceCriteria: Tests cover save, load, continue, restart, and post-ending load
Tests cover route, identity, relationship, event history, and time fields
npm test passes

userStories.title: Include Save Restore in Gameplay Simulation
userStories.description: As a developer, I want gameplay simulation to periodically save and restore so that long-run persistence is validated.
acceptanceCriteria: Simulation can auto-save by age or event interval
Simulation restores from at least one save and continues
Report includes save count, load count, and consistency check results
npm test passes

userStories.title: Generate P2 Gameplay Structure Report
userStories.description: As a project owner, I want P2 output evidence so the project can decide whether it is ready for P3.
acceptanceCriteria: Report includes choice feedback coverage, route completion rate, route breakage rate, simulation metrics, and save consistency
Report lists residual risks
Report identifies P3 candidate follow-ups

userStories.title: Close P2 with Verification Evidence
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want P2 closed with fresh validation evidence so future sessions can continue safely.
acceptanceCriteria: npm run typecheck passes
npm run build passes
npm test passes
P2 simulation, save, or route quality commands pass or emit approved waivers
Completed P2 stories have recorded verification evidence
